OPERATOR_RUNBOOK: Reconciler heartbeat monitor implemented via GHA scheduled-canary.

## Heartbeat Service
GitHub Actions workflow: .github/workflows/reconcile-bridge-canary.yml
Schedule: every hour (0 * * * *) + workflow_dispatch

## Configuration
- Alert window: ALERT_WINDOW_HOURS (default 2h, overridable via workflow_dispatch input)
- Alert mechanism: GitHub Issue with label 'heartbeat-alert' (idempotent — one open alert at a time)
- Self-healing: canary auto-closes the alert issue when reconciler recovers
- Failure visibility: canary job exits non-zero when stale (appears as failed run in GHA UI)

## How to test (simulated disable)
1. Navigate to Actions > Reconciler Heartbeat Canary > Run workflow
2. Set dry_run=false, alert_window_hours=2 (or 0 to force immediate alert)
3. Verify a GitHub Issue with label 'heartbeat-alert' is created (satisfies closure check)
4. After verification, close the issue manually or wait for a successful reconcile-bridge run

## Status
Implementation complete as of commit d3d8560. Test alert pending push to GitHub and first canary dispatch.
